title: SMART — SATA boot drives
description:
Companion to the community SMARTctl Exporter Dashboard (id 22604). That dashboard's 'Wear Level on SATA Devices' panel hard-codes the Samsung/Crucial-style attribute name (Wear_Leveling_Count) which neither the Toshiba THNSF8400CCSE nor the Intel SSDSC2BX400G4 boot drives in this cluster report. This dashboard uses Media_Wearout_Indicator instead, which both vendors do report.

Gauge value is `100 - normalized` so it reads 'percentage worn' (0 = pristine, 100 = end-of-life), matching the semantic of the NVMe wear gauges in the community dashboard.

panels.title: Wear Level on SATA Devices
panels.description: Media_Wearout_Indicator (normalized, 100 = pristine), displayed as 100 - value so it reads as percentage worn. Matches the visual semantic of the community dashboard's NVMe wear panel.

panels.title: Raw SMART wear attributes (debug)
panels.description: Side-by-side view of every wear-related attribute the SATA SSDs expose. Use this if you want to see Workld_Media_Wear_Indic on the Intel drive (workload-relative wear; differs slightly from the lifetime Media_Wearout_Indicator).
